summary: HeartSciences filed an 8-K reporting that Fortitude Mining Holdings named Jaime Leverton as CEO and a director effective September 21, 2026, and Andrea Childs as COO, with Childs resigning as Fortitude CEO and director. The appointments occur inside the previously announced June 23, 2026 merger agreement among HeartSciences, Fortitude, Fortitude Mining HoldCo and Cordis Acquisition. Post-closing, HeartSciences is expected to be renamed Fortitude Mining Group, Inc., with Leverton serving as its CEO and director. Watch whether this leadership reshuffle signals integration readiness or governance friction ahead of closing. No deal terms were disclosed.
